description: Generate a properly formatted llms.txt file for a website. Crawls the site's sitemap, groups pages by section, pulls page titles and descriptions, and produces both the llms.txt content and a companion robots.txt snippet. The AI client can then write the returned content to disk in the user's project. Requires an API key.
